extension.description: Open or attach to tmux sessions named after the current workspace folder, in a dedicated terminal view in the Secondary Side Bar.
view.terminal.name: Terminal
config.notifyOnBell: Show a notification when a tmux session's terminal bell rings (e.g. an AI CLI needs your attention).
config.notifySound: Play a sound alongside the bell notification, so you notice it even away from the screen. On by default.
config.notifyToast: Show the pop-up notification (toast) when a session rings the bell. On by default; turn it off to keep only the sound. To silence both, set `notifyOnBell` to false instead.
config.notifySoundPreset: Which sound to play when the bell notification fires. Preview each one by changing this setting and triggering a bell.
config.notifySoundPresetOnAsk: Which sound to play when the bell is an "ask" (waiting for your input, e.g. a permission prompt) rather than a completed turn. Requires the reference bell-reason hook script (see the README); without it every bell uses the plain sound preset. Defaults to Siren Sweep so it stands out from the completion sound.
config.notifyBridgeStatusline: Append the session's context usage and cost to the bell notification, read from the statusline bridge file. Requires the reference `statusline.sh` (see the README); has no effect without it. On by default.
config.terminal.fontFamily: Font family for the Tmux terminal view. Leave empty to use the editor's font family.
config.terminal.fontSize: Font size (px) for the Tmux terminal view. Leave unset to match the editor's font size.
config.profiles.command: Shell command run as the session's process, e.g. "claude".
config.profiles.description: Text shown beside the profile in the picker. Defaults to the command.
config.profiles.sessionSuffix: Session-name suffix, as in "<workspace>-<suffix>". Defaults to a slug of the profile name.
config.profiles.updateCommand: Command that updates the profile's tool, e.g. "claude update". When set, an Update button appears in the toolbar for this profile's session. Omit for tools without a single self-update command.
